title: Redox full-state smoke and restart
question: Can the 4,503-state configuration with amino-acid delivery, GSH recycling, and explicit NADPH supply advance and resume within tolerance?

model.scenario: C08 with fixed 120 s acid removal, phase-tested Burley kinetics, and middle redox supply

initial_state: Fresh baseline constructed by run_demo.py for the declared model, profile, and candidate. No input checkpoint.
run: python -I -B -X utf8 run_demo.py --protocol smoke --profile Burley --candidate C08 --redox-v15 --check-restart --output outputs/redox-smoke

reference.provenance: Captured with Python 3.12.10 and the pinned dependencies on macOS ARM64 from commit 5b0685dea211b27588029d29c4011b6075bfb7fe, before the checker refactor.

interpretation_limit: A 20 ms check of numerical integration and continuation. It cannot establish redox steady state or validate human motor-neuron biology.
